monitored_text: Do you provide design support? What are your lead times? What file formats do you accept? Can you handle validation and testing? Yes. Our team offers DFM (Design for Manufacturability) feedback to help optimize part geometry, reduce machining time, and lower cost. Lead times vary by part complexity, material, and volume. Low-volume production orders can usually ship in within days. We typically work with STEP, IGES, and STL files, and our engineering team can accommodate most common CAD formats. Yes. We provide CMM dimensional inspection, material certifications, and First Article Inspection (FAI) documentation.
